task: independent d=5 Weyl-compatible lift candidate audit

claims.statement: There is a unital CPTP, Hilbert-Schmidt-self-adjoint, Weyl-covariant self-compatible channel on M_5 whose unweighted projective-line peak budget sum_L max_{x in L\{0}} (2 lambda_x - 1)_+ exceeds one; for the displayed exact Q(sqrt(5)) channel the value is (6294997 + 953616 sqrt(5))/6303442 > 1.
claims.quantifiers: Existence of one explicit channel in dimension d=5; no universal statement.
claims.interface: The Weyl error distribution is q_m=v_m^2/N; its finite self-compatibility witness is X=vv^T/N under the compatibility-kernel criterion.
claims.source_pointer: Haapasalo, finite-phase-space Corollary 2, Eq. (22), for the compatibility-kernel criterion.
claims.costs: Exact map data consists of 25 entries in Q(sqrt(5)); X is rank one. No acquisition or asymptotic cost.
claims.novelty_boundary: Refutes only the naive arbitrary-Weyl extension that sums the positive peak on each maximal-isotropic line. It does not contradict the line-constant theorem and does not refute existence of a general EB comparator.
claims.falsifier: An error in the five exact Fourier fixed-vector identities, the finite compatibility formula, or exact spectrum arithmetic would invalidate the witness.
claims.next_gate: Seek a Weyl-compatible channel for which every EB comparator fails the factor-two Hilbert-Schmidt order, or prove the universal EB comparator by a method not restricted to MUB line mixtures.

claims.statement: For the exact Q(sqrt(5)) d=5 channel in QBL-D5-1 there is a Weyl-covariant entanglement-breaking channel Psi satisfying I-Psi <= 2(I-Phi) in Hilbert-Schmidt operator order.
claims.quantifiers: One common EB comparator for the displayed single d=5 channel.
claims.interface: Psi is the exact rational-weighted mixture of six Weyl twirls of product Choi states obtained by interpreting the decimal coordinates and weights in d5_eb_comparator.json as exact decimals, normalizing each ket exactly, and normalizing the positive weights exactly.
claims.costs: Six five-component kets, six positive rational weights, and 24 scalar order checks. Exact Fraction interval arithmetic proves direct gaps above 59/2500 and clipped gaps above 139/10000; no runtime or acquisition capability claim.
claims.evidence: Minimum direct order gap mu_x-(2 lambda_x-1) is approximately 0.02363671263988624; minimum clipped-threshold gap is approximately 0.01396612069855287. All 24 nonidentity modes were interval-checked positive. Identity mode is equality.
claims.novelty_boundary: A single-instance comparator witness only. Interval arithmetic and construction have not received formal verification or external review; this is not the arbitrary-dimension operator lemma or the bounded-Holevo family theorem.
claims.falsifier: A valid exact evaluation of any one of the 24 mode gaps as nonpositive, or a failure of the Bell-twirl product Choi construction to have maximally mixed marginals, would invalidate this claim.
claims.next_gate: Independent exact arithmetic review of the interval script; continue to search for an obstruction to a common EB comparator beyond this instance.
